description: List available plugins (payments, shipping, marketing, analytics, trust, support, bookings, ai, localization) and their configuration state for a website, toggle a plugin on/off, and set its NON-SECRET fields. Secret fields (API keys, passwords) can never be read or set here — configured shows true/false only, and writes to secret fields are rejected. Secrets must be entered by the seller in the dashboard under Apps & Plugins. Use category="shipping" to scope to couriers before manage_shipping actions.

fields.description: set: non-secret field values to write, e.g. { flatRate: "60" }. Secret fields (see field.secret in list output) are rejected.

pluginId.description: set: plugin id, e.g. "dhl-express" — required for set

name: manage_plugins
